root_cause: Confirmed at the selected historical commit by a formatter regression and fresh ABB before/after runs. Shell execution supplies a combined output buffer. ShellToolInvocation.formatNormalOutput labels that buffer Stdout and unconditionally appends Stderr: (empty); the tool description also promises separate streams. The local patch labels the buffer Output (stdout and stderr combined) and documents that stream attribution is unavailable. The same two-stream command no longer produces a false empty-stderr claim. This repair makes the merged-output contract truthful; it does not reconstruct separate stdout and stderr streams and is not an upstream merged fix.
